page.overview:
Who is Sergey Rozhenko?

Sergey Rozhenko was a Human male who served as a Starfleet chief petty officer and warp field specialist during the 24th century.

Rozhenko was married to Helena Rozhenko and had one son, Nikolai Rozhenko. ()

In 2346, Rozhenko served aboard the under Captain Drew Dieghan when the ship answered a Klingon distress call following the Romulan attack on the Khitomer outpost. In the wreckage of the outpost, Sergey discovered a young Klingon named Worf. In an act of kindness, Sergey and Helena fostered Worf. ()

In 2347, the Rozhenko family was residing on the farming colony of Gault where Worf and Nikolai grew up. (; )
